'''Drev Hassin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]], Drev Hassin was well-versed in the teachings of his culture despite leaving his homeworld to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Selected for one-on-one training by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]], Hassin became his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and served loyally during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] he embarked with Druur on a mission to locate Druur's former Padawan [[Saes Rrogon]], who had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They found him with the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and reported their findings back to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], before tracking him to the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]]. There, Rrogon, in command of the [[Sith dreadnaught]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], was [[Mining/Legends|mining]] for the powerful [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] on a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Phaegon III]]. Hassin and Druur, [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] an [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]; Druur infiltrated the ''Harbinger'' and attempted to destroy the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] so that it would not be able to deliver its valuable ore to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] while Hassin was assaulted by several [[Blade-class starfighter|''Blade''-class starfighters]] deployed by the ''Harbinger'' and its sister ship, ''[[Omen]]''.<ref name="CC" />

Hassin held off against the enemy fighters for a time while Druur sabotaged the ''Harbinger''{{'s}} hyperdrive and engaged in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] with Rrogon. However, Hassin was unable to last, and decided to ram the Infiltrator into the bridge of the ''Harbinger''. The dreadnaught was unable to avoid his [[Death/Legends|suicidal]] tactic, and Hassin's final act caused the ''Harbinger'' to crash into the ''Omen'' just as the ships attempted to flee into hyperspace. This caused the ''Omen'' to crash-land on the remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], where its [[Lost Tribe of Sith|survivors]] remained stranded for thousands of years, while the ''Harbinger'' entered an unstable [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] which launched them 5,000 years into the future, to [[41 ABY]]. There, Druur, disheartened by Hassin's death, fell to the dark side before [[Mission to the Harbinger|confronting]] Rrogon a second time in a duel which led to both their deaths and the destruction of the ''Harbinger''.<ref name="CC" />
